metadata.title: Real Estate ERP Platform Deployment Channels
metadata.description: Product bricks are deployed to the organisation's back-office web app, the branded tenant, owner, supplier and VvE owner portals, the tenant and technical field mobile apps, the open REST API and certified integration connectors (accounting, banking, BI, e-mail, e-signing, maintenance partners, rent-price check), the hyper automation and AI runtime, and the internal tenant-administration, migration and support back office. All runtimes are hosted in the European Union with EU data residency for Dutch and German tenants. Each deployed brick records the products that use it.

channels.description: Browser-based workspaces for organisation staff, tenants, owners, apartment owners and maintenance suppliers, one sub-channel per major web application; hosted in EU data centres with data residency in the European Union.

The organisation's browser-based ERP workspace covering the Relaties, Objecten, Projecten, Contracten, Financieel, Techniek, VvE and Rapportages modules for asset managers, property managers, controllers, technical managers and VvE administrators. Hosted in EU data centres with data residency in the European Union for Dutch and German tenants.
